```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'Release candidate tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate RC and Stable Tags
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      rc_tag: ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.rc_tag }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.stable_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.set_vars.outputs.commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set variables
        id: set_vars
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rc_tag="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable_tag="${rc_tag%-rc*}"
          commit_sha=$(git rev-parse "$rc_tag")
          echo "rc_tag=$rc_tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "stable_tag=$stable_tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "commit_sha=$commit_sha" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify RC tag exists
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if ! git ls-remote --tags origin "$rc_tag" | grep -q "$rc_tag$"; then
            echo "RC tag $rc_tag does not exist on remote."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify Stable tag does not exist
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if git ls-remote --tags origin "$stable_tag" | grep -q "$stable_tag$"; then
            echo "Stable tag $stable_tag already exists on remote."
            exit 1
          fi

  promote:
    name: Promote RC to Stable
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Create stable git tag
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rc_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          commit_sha="${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}"
          git tag -a "$stable_tag" -m "Promote RC $rc_tag to stable" "$commit_sha"
          git push origin "$stable_tag"

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Re-tag Docker images (grafana/beyla)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rc_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla:"$stable_tag" \
            grafana/beyla:"$rc_tag"

      - name: Re-tag Docker images (grafana/beyla-k8s-cache)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rc_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:"$stable_tag" \
            grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:"$rc_tag"

      - name: Set up GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Create stable GitHub release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          stable_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          gh release create "$stable_tag" \
            --generate-notes \
            --title "Release $stable_tag" \
            --prerelease=false

      - name: Copy binary assets from RC to stable release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rc_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }}"
          stable_tag="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          asset_urls=$(gh release view "$rc_tag" --repo . --json assets --jq '.assets[].url')
          for url in $asset_urls; do
            asset_name=$(basename "$url")
            curl -L -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" "$url" -o "$asset_name"
            gh release upload "$stable_tag" "$asset_name"
            rm "$asset_name"
          done

      - name: Promotion Summary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "::notice::✅ RC ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }} promoted to stable ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}."
          echo "::notice::📌 Checklist:"
          echo "::notice::- Update Helm chart to reference ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}."
          echo "::notice::- Publish updated technical documentation."
```
